nodes.speaker: Tobb
nodes.text: Mmph! You're not goblins. Please, the ropes. They went to fetch the chief and they'll be back.

choices.text: Hold still. We'll cut you loose.
What do you know about Grak?

nodes.speaker: Tobb
nodes.text: Bless you. I'll wait here; I'm not walking past those things alone. Go on, finish it.

nodes.speaker: Tobb
nodes.text: My wrists will heal. My flour won't. Just get Grak out of my keep. Well, the lord's keep.

nodes.speaker: Tobb
nodes.text: He's scared of fire, I think. He kept the torches in his hall lit all night and shouted at anyone who let one gutter.

nodes.speaker: Tobb
nodes.text: Big, he's big, and he shouts, and there's the smell, and... sorry. I can't think straight.
